title: Optical experiment setup in an open equipment enclosure
visual_facts: A desktop monitor at the lower left displays a dark image with a bright circular spot and ring-like pattern.
A black rectangular enclosure sits open on the right, exposing mounted components and several colored cables.
Several small cylindrical optical components rest on the white work surface near the monitor and enclosure.
The enclosure lid is hinged and propped open.
spatial_relations: The open instrument enclosure sits beside the monitor on the same counter.
Small optical components are arranged on the counter in front of the enclosure.
uncertainties: The optical setup and the meaning of the displayed pattern cannot be determined from this view.
